about_the_game:
Uku Pacha is a boss rush adventure inspired by Andean mythology. You play as a young musician betrayed and sacrificed, who awakens in the Uku Pacha—the Andean underworld. To return to the world of the living, you must face the Amarus, colossal guardians tied to the elements and the stars. Each battle challenges your reflexes, timing, and ability to strike in rhythm with your enemy’s flow.

Features:

  • Boss Rush Gameplay – Confront five unique bosses, each with distinct attack patterns, elemental powers, and rhythm-based mechanics.

  • Rhythm-Infused Combat – Time your attacks with the flow of your foes to unleash powerful strikes and counters.

  • Mythological World – Journey through the Uku Pacha, the underworld of Andean myth, brought to life with atmospheric art and music.

  • Narrative Adventure – Discover the tale of betrayal, sacrifice, and resilience as you search for a way back to the living world.

  • Atmospheric Soundtrack – An original score blending traditional Andean instruments with modern arrangements, syncing with the intensity of combat.

  • Challenging but Rewarding – Master patterns, learn timing, and overcome mighty guardians in a focused, skill-based adventure.

content_descriptors.notes:
Uku Pacha contains themes that may not be suitable for all audiences. The story features the betrayal and ritual sacrifice of the protagonist, presented in a mythological context without gore or graphic violence. Players will encounter dark, otherworldly environments and intense battles against colossal guardians.

The game does not include sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (latest updates)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 1 GB VRAM or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible with surround sound support

short_description: Uku Pacha is a rhythm-infused boss rush inspired by Andean mythology. Face 5 colossal guardians of the underworld, learn their attack patterns, and strike in sync with their rhythm to carve your path back to the world of the living.
